layout_intent:
Grove_00 V002 concept proposal, NOT implemented or validated. Inner spherical world radius 300m unchanged. Schematic unwrapped triangular octant, no literal flat world. Seven colossal trees with irregular thick buttresses and forked bare trunks; ground-level continuous network. Trunk diameters 35–60m, heights 100–170m (boss forked ancient tree 170m). Root ridges 8–15m tall, 40–80m reach, broad navigable sloped sections and wide ground routes around tips. Clearings 45–70m across, main walk passages 18–28m wide. No canopy roof, floating islands, treehouses, towers, buildings, rivers or new gameplay devices. Muted grey-green #718767 ground, warm dark brown wood, restrained technical layout drawing.
Consistent full layout on a triangular map with apex north, base south. Exactly seven main tree bases, positions as percentages of map bounding box (left to right, top to bottom): T1 western guardian (34,60), T2 central massive fork (53,53), T3 eastern giant (73,62), T4 northwest giant (42,40), T5 northern ancient split boss landmark (53,25), T6 southwest giant (30,80), T7 southeast giant (63,81). Root footprints extend irregularly but remain within sector; avoid too-close intersections that wall off routes. Five clearly shaped open ground spaces between the roots: A southwest clearing around (44,73), B west clearing around (33,47), C east clearing around (66,46), D boss clearing immediately south of northern split tree around (54,35), E southeast clearing around (73,77). Adjust only slightly as needed to maintain broad clearance; clearings are distinct spaces bounded by multiple trees and low root ridges, never small dots in empty terrain. Main ground loop A-B-D-C-E-A with a ground cross route A-C around the south/east side of central trunk; meaningful intermittent sight blocking. Shallow recovery hollow at east of E around (81,69), 6–10m below nearby ground; wide sloping walk-return, optional recovery hook. Three border entrances: northwest edge to B, northeast edge to C, south edge to A. Landmark reads above the forest from main approaches; open sky over combat spaces. Representative first-build zone is west-central cluster T1 T2 T4 with A and B connected by two clear ground flanks and one optional root traverse. Small Pod candidate symbols in A B C D E only signify candidate spaces, not changed world spawn totals. Optional cyan hook shortcuts at root crossing and hollow recovery, not the main route. Cut line A-A' horizontally across west clearing B, central giant T2, east clearing C and recovery hollow; side image follows this conceptual cut, projecting nearby root ridges, with northern boss landmark in distant background.

Show monumental roots and multiple massive trunk footprints that genuinely define fighting clearings. Clean readable hand-painted architectural map with crisp pencil/ink outlines, light orthographic volume shading and muted colors on warm ivory sheet. STRICT true top-down orthographic view: look vertically down, emphasize tree base footprints and branching roots, NO foliage canopies hiding the floor. Whole triangular octant occupies almost all sheet with three entrances and boundary buffer. Roots are broad sculptural landforms, taper to ground and create navigable ground lanes. Retain substantial open fighting areas between trees; trees and roots collectively occupy a meaningful large fraction of interior, not a few isolated tiny circles.

Display exactly seven varied large tree-base masses T1–T7, not identical cylinders. Wood buttresses are asymmetric, forked outlines and thick roots. Main giant central footprint should be around 50–60m width relative to a 50m scale bar. Tree stumps/bases oversized like monumental ruins, no leaves/grass illustration. Show grey-green ground terrain grading, taupe contour lines around root ridges, low berms. Depict the five fighting clearings as actual distinct negative-space shapes with unobstructed inner areas, not graphic circles drawn atop unshaped flat terrain. Ground continuity across all zones.
Route overlay: warm amber broad thin arrows for walk loop; dashed amber for cross route; cyan dashed small optional hook arrows only two; blue return arrows in hollow. White dash outline around representative west-central zone. Sparse clear Korean labels integrated outside busy footprints, using exact labels where possible: "거목 군집", "공터 A", "공터 B", "공터 C", "공터 E", "보스 공터", "갈라진 고목", "측면 우회", "뿌리 횡단", "회복 분지", "보행 복귀", "경계 진입", "대표 구역". Use neat thin leaders. Include cut line "A — A′" horizontally across map. Include a clear graphical 50m scale bar and small legend with trunk/root, walking, optional hook, Pod candidate. At bottom, a compact assumption line: "구상안 · 구면 옥탄트 펼친 개념도 · 반지름 300m 유지 · 치수는 검토용". Add metric notes "줄기 Ø35–60m", "공터 폭 45–70m", "주 보행 폭 18–28m". No claim of validated geometry. Avoid dense paragraph text, unnecessary decorative border, photorealism, tiny illegible labels, foliage, empty field, dungeon maze, buildings. 3:2 landscape composition.
side_view_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / infographic-diagram.
Create ONE NEW standalone high-resolution landscape SIDE ELEVATION concept drawing for a game level, corresponding to the supplied Grove_00 TOP VIEW reference. This is the second of two proposed spatial drawings. The reference is layout/style guidance, NOT an edit target. Do NOT simply reproduce its small side inset; make the monumental trunks the dominant subject and show their actual enormous height. Title "GROVE_00 / V002 — SIDE VIEW". Clean professionally drawn architectural/game level design plate on matching warm ivory paper. Crisp ink/pencil contour, carefully shaded blockout volumes, dark warm brown wood and muted grey-green #718767 ground. Not photorealism; no ornate fantasy ornamentation. Visually readable and spatially useful for deciding scale before modeling.

Explicitly label "동서 측면 개념도 · A–A′ 인근 구조물 투영". Use local gravity vertical, terrain unwrapped to make heights readable; this is NOT a flat-world claim. Label the small footer "구면 지면 R=300m · 펼친 측면 개념도 · 치수는 검토용".
Foreground composition, left to right: massive WEST tree T1 with broad buttressed base 40m diameter and trunk 110m high; well-shaped OPEN clearing B with 50–60m free fighting width and tiny Pod candidate; gigantic CENTRAL tree T2, 55–60m diameter and 140m high, with a forked main trunk breaking into just a few colossal bare upper limbs, broad asymmetric rooting 8–15m tall over the lower 40–70m; OPEN clearing C 55–65m fighting width with tiny Pod; EAST tree T3 approximately 40m diameter and 120m high slightly farther back; shallow recovery hollow to the far right 6–10m deep, with broad easily walkable inclined ground-return to clearing C/E and one optional cyan recovery hook indicator at the rim. Projection may overlap distant roots, but primary ground route visibly continues in front/behind tree bases, never requires climbing a tree.
Background ancient northern split boss tree T5 rises to 170m behind center-right, light desaturated brown so clearly background. It must be a huge recognizable split ancient silhouette, visibly taller and broader than neighboring trees, with a low boss clearing indicated at its ground base. Ghosted T4/T6/T7 background silhouettes may be very faint, never obscure foreground labels. Do not depict seven trunks all lined up in foreground: this is one directional projection of the reference layout, not a tree lineup.
CRITICAL SCALE: these are colossal landform-scale trees, NOT human-sized stumps. The trees must rise almost to top of image with full visible silhouettes; thick tapering trunks and large clearings, no framing crop of their tops. Place a truly tiny 1.9m human player silhouette and 2.5m Pod at the ground in B and C, draw a neat magnified player legend separately at lower left if needed, but NEVER enlarge the real figures to look comparable to trees. Add thin height ruler on left at 0, 50, 100, 150m; main tallest 170m. Show metric dimension leaders for "거목 높이 100–170m", "줄기 굵기 35–60m", "뿌리 능선 8–15m", "회복 분지 −6~−10m". Use clear understated labels "공터 B", "공터 C", "갈라진 고목 / 보스 랜드마크", "지상 주 동선", "뿌리 위 선택 경로", "보행 복귀", "플레이어 1.9m". Include minimal amber walking arrows at ground level and one cyan optional hook trajectory, with open sky over combat areas and plenty of airspace between upper bare limbs.
Avoid any canopy ceiling or leaves, floating islands, elevated village, tower, treehouse, architecture, waterfall, bridges as mandatory paths, dark dramatic sky, dense tiny text, map panel, isometric top view, cliffs blocking return. Emphasize dimensional volume and meaningful terrain relationships, not beautiful empty grass. 3:2 wide landscape composition, legible Korean labels.
